Class GameState

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.galaxytrucker.model.gameClasses.GameState
public class GameState extends Object
This class describes the entire status of the game, the controller will invoke its methods in order to modify the model according to specific actions performed by the players on the view

    • putShown

      public void putShown(String nickname) throws PickedComponentException, InvalidActionException
      Handles the release of a picked component by a player during the ship building phase. The component is placed face up and made visible to all players.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player releasing the component
      Throws:
      PickedComponentException - if the player has no component to release
      InvalidActionException - if the game is not in ship building phase or if the player has already finished assembling

    • assembleComponent

      public void assembleComponent(String nickname, int x, int y) throws AssembledComponentException, PickedComponentException, InvalidActionException
      Assembles a picked component onto the player's ship board at the specified coordinates. Updates all clients with the assembled component information.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player assembling the component
      x - the x-coordinate where to place the component
      y - the y-coordinate where to place the component
      Throws:
      AssembledComponentException - if there's an issue with component assembly
      PickedComponentException - if the player has no component to assemble
      InvalidActionException - if the game is not in ship building phase or if the player has already finished assembling

    • rotatePickedComponent

      public void rotatePickedComponent(String nickname) throws InvalidActionException, PickedComponentException
      Rotates the currently picked component of a player by changing its orientation.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player rotating the component
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the game is not in ship building phase or if the player has already finished assembling
      PickedComponentException - if the player has no component to rotate

    • pickDeck

      public void pickDeck(String nickname, int deckNumber) throws PickedDeckException, InvalidActionException
      Allows a player to pick a deck during the assembling phase to view its contents. Only available in non-first flight games.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player picking the deck
      deckNumber - the number of the deck to pick (must be valid and not already picked)
      Throws:
      PickedDeckException - if the deck is already picked by another player
      InvalidActionException - if the game is not in ship building phase, if it's a first flight game, if the player has already finished assembling, or if the deck number is invalid

    • releaseDeck

      public void releaseDeck(String nickname) throws InvalidActionException, PickedDeckException
      Releases a previously picked deck, making it available for other players to pick. Only available in non-first flight games.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player releasing the deck
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the game is not in ship building phase, if it's a first flight game, or if the player has already finished assembling
      PickedDeckException - if the player has no deck to release

    • setPosition

      public void setPosition(String nickname, int initCell) throws InvalidPositionException, InvalidActionException
      Sets the starting position of a player on the flight board after they finish assembling their ship. Validates the position based on game level and availability.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player setting their position
      initCell - the initial cell number on the flight board
      Throws:
      InvalidPositionException - if the starting position is invalid or already taken
      InvalidActionException - if the game is not in the appropriate phase or if the player has already set their position

    • startNewCycle

      public void startNewCycle(String nickname) throws InvalidActionException, HourGlassException
      Starts a new cycle by turning the hourglass. Can be invoked by a player who has finished assembling during the ship building phase. Only available in non-first flight games.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player starting the new cycle
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the player hasn't finished assembling, if the game is not in ship building phase, or if it's a first flight game
      HourGlassException - if there's an issue with the hourglass mechanism

    • checkShipBoards

      public void checkShipBoards()
      Checks the correctness of all ships in the game to determine if the flight phase can start. Ships must be well assembled with all cabins full of crew and all containers full of batteries. If all ships are correct, transitions to the card picking phase.

    • createGameDeck

      public void createGameDeck()
      Creates the main game deck by unifying and shuffling the 4 decks used during the assembling phase. This method is invoked after the assembling phase when all ships are ready.

    • setGameState

      public void setGameState(State state)
      Changes the state of the game and notifies all clients. Handles special cleanup when transitioning to the END state.
      Parameters:
      state - the new game state to set

    • setShipRepair

      public void setShipRepair(String nickname)
      Sets the game to ship repair phase for a specific player whose ship has been damaged.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player who needs to repair their ship

    • checkDamages

      public void checkDamages()
      Checks if any ship boards have been damaged and need repair after a card has been solved. If damages are found, sets the game to repair phase; otherwise, returns to card picking phase.

    • updateTurns

      public void updateTurns()
      Orders players by their position on the flight board (descending order) and assigns the leader's nickname to turnPlayer. Updates all clients with the new turn order.

    • nextTurn

      public void nextTurn()
      Updates turnPlayer to the next player in the turn order. If the current player is the last in order, calls updateTurns() to restart from the leader.

    • setTurnPlayer

      public void setTurnPlayer(String nickname)
      Sets the turn player to a specific player's nickname and notifies all clients.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player whose turn it should be

    • forceQuit

      public void forceQuit(String nickname) throws InvalidActionException
      Handles forced disconnection of a player from the game. Manages different scenarios based on the current game state.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player being forcibly disconnected
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if there's an issue processing the disconnection

    • quitGame

      public void quitGame(String nickname, boolean playerDecision) throws InvalidActionException
      Handles a player's request to leave the game or forced removal. Updates turn order and checks for game end conditions.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player quitting
      playerDecision - true if the player chose to quit, false if forced to quit
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the player cannot quit in the current phase

    • pickNextCard

      public void pickNextCard(String nickname) throws InvalidActionException
      Allows the leader to draw a new card from the deck during the card picking phase. Transitions to card solving phase and applies the card's special effect.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player (must be the leader) picking the card
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if the game is not in card picking phase or if the player is not the leader

    • epidemicEffect

      public void epidemicEffect(String nickname) throws InvalidActionException
      Applies epidemic effect to a player's ship, removing crew members from cabins that are directly connected to other busy cabins.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player affected by the epidemic
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if no card has been picked yet

    • removeCrewMembers

      public void removeCrewMembers(String nickname, List<Integer> x, List<Integer> y, List<Integer> crewInEachCabin, int numberCrewToRemove)

      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player removing crew members
      x - list of x-coordinates of cabins
      y - list of y-coordinates of cabins
      crewInEachCabin - list of crew counts in each cabin
      numberCrewToRemove - total number of crew members to remove

    • updatePlayerCredits

      public void updatePlayerCredits(String nickname, int update)
      Updates the cosmic credits of a player and notifies all clients.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player whose credits are being updated
      update - the amount to add or subtract from current credits

    • changePlayerPosition

      Changes a player's position on the flight board by the specified number of cells.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player moving
      cells - the number of cells to move (positive for forward, negative for backward)

      Handles a meteor attack on a player's ship. The player can choose to activate shields or cannons for defense.
      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player being attacked
      meteor - the meteor object containing attack parameters
      direction - the direction of the meteor attack
      activateShield - true to activate shield defense

      InvalidActionException - if no card has been picked yet

      Parameters:
      nickname - the nickname of the player being attacked
      cannonFire - the cannon shot object containing attack parameters
      direction - the direction of the cannon fire attack
      activateShield - true to activate shield defense
      Throws:
      InvalidActionException - if no card has been picked yet

      Substitutes or adds a good in a specific container of a player's cargo hold.

    • computeTotalRewards

      public void computeTotalRewards()
      Computes the total rewards and penalties for all players when the game ends. Includes finish order rewards, best ship rewards, goods sale rewards, and loss penalties.

    • finishOrderReward

      public void finishOrderReward()
      Assigns rewards to players based on their final position order on the flight board. Earlier finishers receive higher rewards.

    • bestShipReward

      public void bestShipReward()
      Assigns a reward to the player with the best ship, determined by having the lowest number of exposed connectors.

    • lossPenalty

      public void lossPenalty()
      Assigns penalties to each player based on the number of components they lost during the game.

    • saleOfGoodsReward

      public void saleOfGoodsReward()
      Assigns rewards to each player based on the number and type of goods they are carrying. Players who abandoned the game receive half the normal reward.

    • setEndGameManagement

      public void setEndGameManagement(Runnable endGameManagement)
      Sets the callback procedure to be executed when the game ends.
      Parameters:
      endGameManagement - the Runnable to execute for end-game cleanup

    • cancelGame

      public void cancelGame()
      Executes the callback procedure to remove the controller from the server's list and perform other end-game cleanup.
